abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.description: Nurtures an ally with the power of nature, restoring their health. Healing scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Revitalizing Waters
abilities.description: The Father of the Forest blesses an allied target with empowering waters. Restoring mana and temporarily increasing their damage

abilities.name: Nature's Grace
abilities.description: The Father of the Forest passively grants nearby allies bonus armor when they're in his vicinity, additionally whenever an ally is attacked while affected by this aura they heal nearby allies. Healing scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Mass Entangle
abilities.description: Calls upon the power of nature causing vines to sprout from the earth beneath nearby enemies, entangling them and dealing damage. The damage scales on Intelligence.

abilities.name: Wrath of Nature
abilities.description: Summons a massive War Ent to fight alongside the Father of the Forest. The health and damage scales on the Intelligence of the Father of the Forest.

abilities.name: Void Burst
abilities.description: Deals damage to an enemy based on the Intelligence of the Void Entity. If the damage would kill the target the Void Burst ability gains permanent bonus damage.

abilities.name: Summon Voidstone
abilities.description: Summons a Void Stone with an aura that grants one random of the following bonuses: Armor, Damage, Health Regeneration, Mana Regeneration or Attack and Movement speed

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.description: Drains health from an enemy target over time, the last ally targeted with Lost Soul will recieve the leeched health.

abilities.name: Lost Soul
abilities.description: Heal a friendly target, or damages an enemy target. Healing/Damage scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Eye of the Void
abilities.description: Surrounds the Void Entity in a mist of concentrated void energy that constantly drains the mana of the Void Entity, while damaging and healing nearby allies every second.

abilities.name: Ancient Presence
abilities.description: The Ancient Marksman's presence increases the damage of nearby allied units.

abilities.name: Dark Veil
abilities.description: Shrouds the Ancient Marksman in a thick mist, making him impervious to damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Shot
abilities.description: The Ancient Marksman marks a target for the perfect shot, after a delay, firing a shot that deals massive damage and stunning the target. Damage scales with Agility.

abilities.name: Split Shot
abilities.description: The Ancient Marksman fires additional arrows at enemies near his primary target. During this time, his attack speed is increased.

abilities.name: Soul Hunt
abilities.description: Grants the Ancient Marksman a temporary buff that grants attack damage. Killing units while this buff is active grants the Ancient Marksman permanent Agility

abilities.name: Enhance Song
abilities.description: Adds an additional effect to the next song used within 30 seconds.

abilities.name: Song of Despair
abilities.description: Intimidates nearby enemies dealing damage and cast an aura that reduces the attack and movement speed of nearby enemies. If affected by Enhance Song the damage and slow is doubled.

values.label: Base Attack and Movement Speed Slow

abilities.name: Song of War
abilities.description: Grants nearby allies increased attack damage for a short duration. If affected by Enhance Song, cast an aura that also increases attack and movement speed.

values.label: Enhance Song Attack and Movement Speed Bonus

abilities.name: Song of Victory
abilities.description: Inspire nearby allies, restoring health and mana over a short duration. If affected by Enhance Song, instantly restore the health and mana upon cast as a bonus effect.

abilities.name: Song of Immortality
abilities.description: Makes the Legionsong Countess and a targeted ally invulnerable for a short duration, and restoring maximum health and mana. If affected by Enhance Song, slightly increase the duration and restore more maximum health and mana plus a flat amount based on the Intelligence of the Legionsong Countess.

abilities.name: Divine Wrath
abilities.description: Grants the Royal Guard increased attack speed, during this time the Royal Guard's attacks has a chance to reduce the current cooldown of all his abilities.

abilities.name: Mark of the Phoenix
abilities.description: Marks an enemy as a living bomb, after 2.5 seconds the target will be stunned and explode dealing damage to nearby enemies, the target is also slowed during the duration.

abilities.name: Royal Barrier
abilities.description: Bathes nearby allied targets in holy light, increasing their armor and granting them bonus mana regeneration for a short duration

abilities.name: Bouncing Glaive
abilities.description: The Royal Guard has mastered the art of the glaive, allowing his attacks to bounce between enemies.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.description: Summons a storm of holy light that purifies the area, dealing massive area of effect damage to enemies near it and briefly stunning them throughout its duration.

abilities.name: Fel Imprisonment
abilities.description: Imprisons an enemy target, rendering them unable to act for a duration. Attacking them while they are imprisoned will remove this effect.

abilities.name: Demon Burn
abilities.description: The Demon Slayer burns an enemy with intense energy, dealing damage based on his agility and restores mana. If the target is branded it restores health aswell.

abilities.name: Lycoris Radiata
abilities.description: The Demon Slayer passively brands enemies on attacks. On activation the Demon Slayer slashes nearby enemies dealing damage based on his agility, if enemies are branded, they take double ability damage.

abilities.name: Felforged
abilities.description: The Demon Slayer passively gains enhanced combat abilities.

abilities.name: Felfire Comet
abilities.description:
Ability Passive: The Demon Slayer has a chance to gain Felspark stacks when attacking enemies affected by Felbrand.
Ability Active: Calls down a comet from the sky, dealing damage to all enemies based on the amount of Felsparks the Demon Slayer has.

abilities.name: Blink Strike
abilities.description: The Iron Raven teleports to an enemy after a short delay, stunning them and dealing damage based on her Agility.

abilities.name: Expose Weakness
abilities.description: The Iron Raven's presence intimidates nearby enemies, reducing their armor.

abilities.name: Iron Feathers
abilities.description: The Iron Raven hurls a flurry of knives, damaging nearby enemies. Damage scales with Agility

abilities.name: Eluding Stance
abilities.description: The Iron Raven becomes swift as the wind, allowing her to dodge enemy attacks.

abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: The Iron Raven becomes the incarnation of vengeance, during this time she gains bonus Agility and her attacks deal bonus damage based on her Agility.

abilities.name: Harden Exoskeleton
abilities.description: The Bone Emperor takes a defensive stance, temporarily increasing his armor. Using Harden Exoskeleton while already affected by the buff causes Exoskeleton Burst, consuming the buff to deal damage to nearby enemies and heal the Bone Emperor.

abilities.name: Spiked Exoskeleton
abilities.description: Passively increases the Bone Emperor's armor, returning damage to enemy units' on their attacks.

abilities.name: Absorb Bone Marrow
abilities.description: The Bone Emperor attempts to extract an enemy target's Bone Marrow, briefly stunning them and dealing damage based on his armor. If this ability kills the target, the Bone Emperor gains permanent bonus armor.

abilities.name: Paralyzing Strike
abilities.description: The Bone Emperor unleashes a toxic paralyzing cloud with his stinger, dealing damage based on his Strength to nearby units and reducing their attack and movement speed.

abilities.name: Terror of the Sands
abilities.description: The Bone Emperor solidifies it's body, temporarily gaining massively increased armor and health regeneration. During this time, Absorb Bone Marrow has reduced cooldown.

abilities.name: Solar Flare
abilities.description: Calls down a Solar Flare from the heavens at the targeted location dealing damage to enemies over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Swift Justice
abilities.description: Strikes an enemy dealing damage based on Sir Daniel's strength and restores health based on Holy Infusion rank, the healing has increased effect.

abilities.name: Holy Infusion
abilities.description: Sir Daniel passively restores health on attacks, he can double this effect temporarily and cause his attacks to deal bonus damage equal to the healing done. Healing scales with Strength.

abilities.name: Glory
abilities.description: Blesses nearby allied units granting them bonus armor and the effect of Sir Daniel's Holy Infusion ability.

abilities.name: Divine Ascension
abilities.description: Sir Daniel ascends, becoming the avatar of light. Upon ascending he punishes nearby enemies dealing damage and increasing his maximum health temporarily. The ascension damage and health gained increases for each enemy unit in his presence upon ascending.

abilities.name: Goring Hew
abilities.description: Strikes an enemy target dealing damage based on Strength and reduce their armor. If the target was already affected by Goring Hew, deal double damage and further reduce their armor.

abilities.name: Reinforce Scales
abilities.description: The Tide Guardian strengthens his scales, causing him to take reduced damage from attacks and increasing his armor temporarily.

abilities.name: Tidal Strike
abilities.description: The Tide Guardian strikes nearby enemies with the power of the tides, dealing damage based on Strength and slowing their attack and movement speed for a short duration.

abilities.name: Kraken's Venom
abilities.description: Causes the Tide Guardian's attacks to apply Kraken's Venom. The Venom deals damage over time and scales with strength. The Tide Guardian heals for some of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Blessing of the Deeps
abilities.description: Blesses an allied hero, causing them to take no damage from attacks or spells for a short duration.

abilities.name: Lightwyrm Brood
abilities.description: The Lightwyrm summons two Lightwyrm whelps to fight by its side for 30 seconds. The health and damage of the whelps scale with the Intelligence and Strength of the Lightwyrm.

values.label: Whelp Strength and Intelligence Damage Scaling
Whelp Strength and Intelligence Health Scaling

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.description: The Lightwyrm strikes an enemy with holy power dealing damage based on its Strength or Intelligence, and restores 100% of the damage dealth as health. The highest attribute is always chosen.

abilities.name: Wyrmblood
abilities.description: The Lightwyrm gains a bonus effect based on which attribute of Strength or Intelligence is highest. If his Strength is higher than Intelligence he restores health based on his strength every 3 seconds. If Intelligence is higher, he and his summons deal additional bonus damage on attacks, based on his Intelligence.

abilities.name: Glorious Roar
abilities.description: The lightwyrm lets out a majestic roar that empowers its allies, massively increasing their health regeneration and damage temporarily.

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.description: The Lightwyrm unleashes a massive nova of light that deals damage to enemies and heals allies. The healing and damage dealt scales with Strength or Intelligence, the highest attribute is always chosen.

abilities.name: Brutal Strikes
abilities.description: Empowers the Berserkers next couple of attacks, causing them to deal bonus damage and have reduced attack interval.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: The Berserker lets out a Battle Cry, restoring his health and increasing his strength temporarily. The health restoration scales with strength.

abilities.name: Puncture
abilities.description: Punctures an enemy target, dealing damage and causing them to bleed, dealing additional damage over time. While punctured they also have reduced armor.

abilities.name: Ruthlessness
abilities.description: The Berserker gains increased Attack Speed everytime he attacks. Every 10th attack, a shockwave occurs, dealing damage to all nearby enemies based on his Strength and resets his passive attack speed bonus

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.description: The Berserker delivers a fatal blow that deals heavy damage and stuns the target, the damage scales with strength and deals bonus damage per 10 missing health of the target.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.description: Deals damage to an enemy or restores health to an allied target, based on Intelligence. If the target is summoned, grant it additional attack damage and double the healing.

abilities.name: Malevolent Hex
abilities.description: Curses an enemy unit, reducing their attack speed and dealing damage to them over time.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.description: Summons a Bone Warrior or Risen Mage to fight for the Dark Spiritualist.

values.label: Bone Warrior Armor Intelligence Scaling per 50 Intelligence

abilities.name: Quirky Bones
abilities.description: Passively increases nearby friendly units' health regeneration. Additionally grant units summoned by the Dark Spiritualist bonus Magic Damage Reduction.

abilities.name: Unholy Might
abilities.description: Causes the Dark Spiritualist' next Empower to turn a Bone Warrior into an Unholy Champion or a Risen Mage into a Death Prophet. They are granted additional bonus health and damage. Unholy Might is consumed when used, and instantly resets the cooldown of the summoned unit.

abilities.name: Prayer
abilities.description: Invokes holy power to heal an allied target. All allied units affected by Holy Beacon are also healed. Healing scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Summon Shadowbeast
abilities.description: The Exiled Priest conjures a Shadowbeast for the target. The Shadowbeast's attacks restores mana to the target equal to 25% of the damage.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: Smites an enemy target, dealing damage based on the Exiled Priest's Intelligence and restores health equal to 50% of the damage to all allies affected by Holy Beacon.

abilities.name: Holy Beacon
abilities.description: Brands an allied target with holy energy, healing them every second over a long duration. Branded targets can be healed through other abilities from the Exiled Priest.

abilities.name: Power Infusion
abilities.description: Blesses an allied Hero with the power of the Exiled Priest's deity, granting them a massive bonus to all Attributes for a short duration.

abilities.name: Ice Shard
abilities.description: Conjure a fast moving shard of ice that deals damage based on the Intelligence of the Frost Mage. If cast on an enemy affected by Winter's Curse 2 additional Ice Shards will be Conjured. These Ice Shards mini-stun.

abilities.name: Winter's Curse
abilities.description: Curses all enemies in an area, dealing damage and slowing them. This effect also exposes them to new effects from the Frost Mage's abilities.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Causes an icy explosion at a targeted location after a short delay, dealing damage to all enemies, if enemies are affected by Winter's Curse, they take additional damage from this ability.

abilities.name: Iceblock
abilities.description: Encases a target in a block of ice, making them invulnerable, but unable to act. If the target is an ally, they are healed.

abilities.name: Endless Winter
abilities.description: The Frost Mage resets the cooldown of her offensive abilities, allowing her to use them again.

abilities.name: Hydra's Breath
abilities.description: Blasts an enemy with a bolt of acid, applying Hydra's Breath to the target. Dealing damage over the duration and reducing their armor. If the target already was affected by Hydra's Breath, the ability deals bonus initial damage.

abilities.name: Storm Blast
abilities.description: Blasts an enemy with lightning, dealing damage and restoring mana equal to the damage dealt to all allies near the target. Damage scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Mending Touch
abilities.description: The Naga Queen blesses an allied target, healing them instantly and placing a healing over time effect on them.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: Increases the movement and attack speed of nearby allies.

abilities.name: Storming Winds
abilities.description: The Naga Queen tosses all enemy targets in a line up into the air, rendering them unable to act and dealing damage based on her Intelligence. Briefly stuns them when the duration ends.

abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.description: The Nether Shaman sacrifices some of his maximum health. Each point of health sacrificed restores a percentage of his Intelligence as mana.

abilities.name: Mana Implosion
abilities.description: The Nether Shaman sacrifices all of their mana to deal damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Healing Tendrils
abilities.description: Calls forth a branching beam of energy that restores health to all allies near an allied target. The healing power is increased by the amount of Maximum Mana the Nether Shaman has.

abilities.name: Energize
abilities.description: The Nether Shaman becomes a conduit of magic, increasing his maximum mana and hastening the rate at which he and his allies regenerate mana.

abilities.name: Mind Drain
abilities.description: Attacks the mind of an enemy, dealing damage based on Maximum Mana and permanently increases the Maximum Mana of the Nether Shaman if this kills the target.

abilities.name: Lightning Strike
abilities.description: Strikes an enemy with a beam of lightning, dealing damage to the target based on the Intelligence of the Thundermancer. Additionally gain stacks of Volatile Energy.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description: The Thundermancer turns into a ball of lightning, becoming invulnerable and massively increasing his movement speed, but can't attack or use abilities while in this form.

abilities.name: Volatile Energy
abilities.description: Every attack grants a stack of Volatile Energy. At 10 stacks, the Thundermancer Empowers his next attack, dealing additional damage in an area around the target. The damage scales with Intelligence.

abilities.name: Charged Attacks
abilities.description: Empowers the Thundermancer's attacks for a short duration, increasing his attack speed and causing his attacks to deal bonus damage based on his Intelligence.

abilities.name: Power Surge
abilities.description: The Thundermancer reduces his base attack interval for a short duration and causes hit next attack to trigger Volatile Energy.

abilities.name: Soul Rip
abilities.description: Tear at the soul of an enemy, dealing damage based on Intelligence. If the target is affected by Piercing Wail, the ability deals 50% bonus damage and stuns.

abilities.name: Veiled Blessing
abilities.description: Blesses all allied targets in an area, restoring their health based on the Weaver of Veil's Intelligence.

abilities.name: Piercing Wail
abilities.description: The Weaver of Veil lets out a shriek, dealing damage to nearby enemies based on Intelligence and reducing their armor for a duration.

abilities.name: Shadow Shell
abilities.description: Enshroud an allied target in shadows for a duration. While enshrouded the target has a chance to completely negate damage taken, when this effect triggers they also restore mana. Only a single target can be affected by Shadow Shell

abilities.name: Threads of Veil
abilities.description: Ability Passive: Grants increased damage on attacks based on Intelligence, additionally the damage done by Threads of Veil heals the target affected by her Shadow Shell. Ability Activation: Conjures a shop that contains up to 11 random Epic and Legendary items. This ability cost gold equal to mana cost, when activated. The shop lasts for 30 seconds or until a single item has been purchased from it.

abilities.name: Cluster Shell
abilities.description: Fires a lightning fast projectile that deals damage to a target and nearby enemies, if the primary target is affected by Napalm Strike the Artillery Team refunds 100% of the mana cost. This ability applies the bonus damage of Heavy Artillery.

abilities.name: Napalm Strike
abilities.description: Fires Napalm at a target that splashes onto nearby enemies. The napalm reduces their armor and deals damage over time.

abilities.name: Armor-Piercing Shells
abilities.description: The Artillery Team loads their cannon with powerful armor piercing shells for the next 3 attacks, slowing their attack speed but making them deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Heavy Artillery
abilities.description: The Artillery Team's attacks fires Heavy Artillery that deals bonus damage to the primary target and nearby enemies. Additionally it has a chance to stun the primary target hit.

abilities.name: Armageddon
abilities.description: The Artillery Team unleashes their most powerful explosive, the Armageddon Shell. After 4 seconds it detonates at the targeted location dealing massive damage to all enemies caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Dexterity
abilities.description: Grants a passive bonus to Agility.

abilities.name: Shuriken Fling
abilities.description: The Bladedancer flings a deadly shuriken at a target dealing heavy damage and briefly stunning them. Damage scales with Agility.

abilities.name: Flurry of Strikes
abilities.description: The Bladedancer enters an agressive stance, massively increasing his attack speed and gives him a chance to deal additional critical damage on attacks.

abilities.name: Blade Dance
abilities.description: The Blade Dancer strikes nearby enemies, dealing damage. Damage scales with Agility

abilities.name: Dancing Duo
abilities.description: Summons an invulnerable uncontrollabe illusion of the Bladedancer that will attack the Bladedancer's target and mimic the Bladedancer's skills when used.

abilities.name: Wild Strike
abilities.description: Swipe at an enemy dealing damage based on the Strength and Agility of the Feral Druid. While Shapeshifted the ability deals additional bonus damage based on the Feral Druid's maximum health.

abilities.name: Untamed Ferocity
abilities.description: Strike an area with such force that unleashes a shockwave that deals damage to all enemies. While Shapeshifted this ability reduces the Cooldown of Feral Rage.

abilities.name: Leader of the Pack
abilities.description: Grants a passive chance on attacks or when being struck to restore health to all nearby allies based on the Feral Druid's Strength. This effect has reduced cooldown while Shapeshifted

abilities.name: Feral Rage
abilities.description: Become enraged, restore a percentage of missing health, reduce damage taken and increase attack speed for a short duration. The damage reduction effect is increased while Shapeshifted

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.description: The Feral Druid shapeshifts into a bear for a duration. Gaining additional Strength and bonus effects on his abilities while in this form.

abilities.name: Strength of Earth
abilities.description: Blesses the Earthbreaker with the power of the mountains, increasing his armor and restoring a percentage of his health periodically, plus a flat amount based on his Strength.

values.label: Periodic Flat Health Restore Strength Scaling

abilities.name: Earth Shake
abilities.description: The Earthbreaker slams the ground with such force that the earth shatters, making enemies lose their footing. Damaging them and reducing their damage temporarily.

abilities.name: Pulverize
abilities.description: The Earthbreaker enrages, slamming his totem in the ground on attacks, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.description: The Earthbreaker's thick skin can withstand incredible force, passively reducing the spell damage he takes and reducing damage taken by attacks.

abilities.name: Destroy
abilities.description: The Earthbreaker crushes an enemy with his totem, dealing damage based on the Earthbreaker's current health and stuns the target.

abilities.name: Death in a Bottle
abilities.description: Throws a volatile bottle containing a deadly mixture, dealing initial damage in an area and creating a mist that deals double damage of the intial damage over time.

abilities.name: Venomtouched Glaive
abilities.description: Empowers the Venomthorn Seer's next attack causing it to deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Withering Curse
abilities.description: Curse an enemy target for a short duration dealing initial damage and causing them to take additional damage while cursed.

abilities.name: Voodoo
abilities.description: Permanently adds a bonus to Intelligence, and gives bonus effects to the Venomthorn Seer's basic abilities.

values.label: Venomtouched Glaive Base Damage per Voodoo Rank

abilities.name: Venomthorn Ward
abilities.description: Sets down a Venomthorn Ward that attacks nearby enemies. The damage of the Ward scales with the Intelligence of the Venomthorn Seer.

abilities.name: Blood Lust
abilities.description: The Blood Lord welcomes allied units to join him on his crusade for blood, increasing their lifesteal while they're in his vicinity. The Blood Lord recieves the bonus aswell.

abilities.name: Undying Hunger
abilities.description: The Blood Lord gives in to his cravings for blood, increasing his damage and lifesteal temporarily.

abilities.name: Reap
abilities.description: The Blood Lord unleashes his fury, clawing all nearby enemies dealing based on his strength. He then shields himself with the blood of his enemies, increasing his armor and health regeneration based on the amount of targets hit by Reap.

abilities.name: Sanguine Rebirth
abilities.description: The Blood Lord casts an aura that restores allied units to a higher health percentage when they take damage while below a certain threshold.

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.description: Drains the blood of the target, dealing damage and heals the Blood Lord based on the damage dealt. Damage scales with Strength.

abilities.name: Mass Impale
abilities.description: The Crypt King impales enemies in an area, dealing damage to them every second.

abilities.name: Rotting Swarm
abilities.description: Creates a swarm of angry locusts that bite and tear at nearby enemies, dealing damage every second, while restoring 50% of the damage as health to the Crypt King and granting him temporary attack damage.

abilities.name: Crypt King's Might
abilities.description: Passively reduces the attack damage of nearby enemies. Additionally, when a neaby enemy dies, theres a chance to spawn a Corpse Beetle, that restores 40% of the damage it deals to the Crypt King as health whenver it attacks.

abilities.name: Feasting Strike
abilities.description: Empowers the Crypt King's next attack causing it to deal bonus damage in an area around the target and heal the Crypt King.

abilities.name: Spiked Carapace
abilities.description: The Crypt King taunts nearby enemies and hardens his exoskeleton temporarily, increasing his armor and causing damage to attackers based on his strength.

abilities.name: Death Strike
abilities.description: The Death Revenant strikes an enemy dealing damage based on Intelligence and granting him Soul Fragments that slowly decay over time. Additionally the Death Revenant gains Soul Fragments on attacks.

abilities.name: Drowning Oblivion
abilities.description: Mark an enemy target for a short duration, storing a percentage of all damage they take. Then consume all Soul Fragments to deal damage to the target. When the mark expires they take damage equal to the stored damage and the Death Revenant restores health and mana based on the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Primordial Being
abilities.description: The Death Revenant passively regenerates maximum health and has a chance on attacks to restore mana. Death Strike has double change of triggering this effect.

abilities.name: Soul Barrier
abilities.description: The Death Revenant consumes a portion of his current mana to temporarily shield himself. The shield blocks all damage equal to mana consumed, until it breaks. The shield's strength is based on mana spent. Additionally the Death Revenant spends a portion of his Soul Fragments to further increase the strength of the shield by 1% per Soul Fragment spent up to 100% increase.

values.label: Soul Fragments Shield Strength Increase
levels: 1% Per 1 Soul Fragment spent up to 100

abilities.name: Soul Discharge
abilities.description: The Death Revenant converts his Soul Fragments into an explosion of energy at the targeted location that deals damage to nearby enemies. Enemies standing closer to the center of the explosion are stunned. The Death Revenant restores mana per Soul Fragment spend.

abilities.name: Lust For Flesh
abilities.description: Incites an allied unit with a madness to rend the flesh of their enemies. Increasing their attack and movement speed temporarily. The Princess of Anguish also has her attack interval reduced while affected by Lust For Flesh.

abilities.name: Succulent Anguish
abilities.description: The Princess of Anguish feeds on the fear of her enemies. Each attack has a chance to deal bonus damage and restore health and mana.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description: The Princess of Anguish teleports to an enemy after a short delay, upon arriving she deals damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Death Scythe
abilities.description: Fire 3 magical scythes at an enemy target, dealing damage. If the target dies, the remaining scythes seek out another target.

abilities.name: Seduce
abilities.description: Briefly stun an enemy and charm them, allowing the Princess of Anguish to control the unit temporarily. If the target is a Boss unit, deal massive damage instead. If the seduced target is brought below 5% health, the effect of Seduce fades.

abilities.name: Killshot
abilities.description: Fires a shot that deals damage based on the Bounty Hunter's agility. If the ability would kill the target, the Bounty Hunter gains gold based on his Agility

abilities.name: Hellspike Trap
abilities.description: The Bounty Hunter carefully places a trap that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage to all enemies caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Marked for Death
abilities.description: Marks an enemy target, reducing their armor. If the target dies while affected by this ability, nearby allies will restore mana based on the Bounty Hunter's Agility.

abilities.name: Bounty Hunt
abilities.description: The Bounty Hunter has a chance to gain bonus gold on units he kills. Additionally he has a chance to deal bonus critical damage on attacks.

abilities.name: Big Boom
abilities.description: The Bounty Hunter fires an incendiary shot that explodes, dealing damage in a small area around the target based on the amount of gold the Bounty Hunter has.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.description: Rain down arrows at a targeted location, dealing damage based on Agility and briefly stunning enemies hit.

abilities.name: Call Elemental Guardian
abilities.description: Calls forth an Elemental Guardian. The damage, health and armor of the Elemental Guardian is based on the Agility of the Elementress.

abilities.name: Incineration Arrows
abilities.description: The Elementress momentarily infuses her arrows with fire, causing her attacks to deal bonus damage in an area around the target.

abilities.name: Frost Shot
abilities.description: Fire a freezing arrow at an enemy dealing damage and slowing the target. If the target is below 50% health the ability deals 50% bonus damage.

abilities.name: Windweaving
abilities.description: Passively reduces the attack speed of nearby enemies. Additionally the Elementress has a chance on a attacks to gain Windsurge, granting her reduced attack interval and increased movement speed temporarily. This effect cannot trigger while active.
